set_aside.subject: deliver_input
set_aside.text: deliver_input: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST take the value the source names and write it before anything reads or checks it: a RecordedSource names a written record; a ListElementSource first makes its list written as that list's own source says, then over a StoredValuesRef takes the element at map_index of the JSON array its StoredValue holds (read_value_bytes) as its own StoredValue of the receiving port's value_schema and the list's class — its bytes canonical_bytes of the element, value_digest content_identity of a BytesContent holding them and value_id content_identity of the StoredValueContent —, and over a SpooledFilesRef the file at that position, as a SpooledFilesRef of that one file with the list's disclosure_class; a MappedListSource names its AssembledList: an AssembledValueList's StoredValue, with its canonical_json as the bytes to publish and to check, or an AssembledFileList's SpooledFilesRef, already written. A StoredValue that is not yet written — a list element, a mapped node's value list — MUST be published with put_value_bytes and written with record_change in one RecordDeliveryValuesChange under the given actor before fit_port_value checks it and before the reference is returned; an equal value already written is returned in its place.

set_aside.subject: empty_list_outputs
set_aside.text: empty_list_outputs: [BEHAVIOR] MUST build, for each output port in port name order, an empty list of the class highest_disclosure_class gives for every input the node received — the mapped list and every other input, a StoredValuesRef counting with its StoredValue's class read through read_records with RecordsById (made only when there is a value_id to name), a SpooledFilesRef with its disclosure_class —: for a value port a StoredValue of the canonical bytes of [] with the canonical array schema with the port's stored schema as items, its bytes published with put_value_bytes, value_digest and value_id computed as for any StoredValue; for a file port an empty SpooledFilesRef. It writes no record: the StoredValue is written in the change of the node's one NodeExecution, which names these outputs.
